claims.statement: Wall painting in the refectory. Ducal correspondence of 1497 presses for completion, but the beginning and end of the work are estimates. Its technical condition is a separate question from its dating.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Ducal correspondence, 1497; stylistic and technical study.
